question: Which divine epithets are invoked at the conclusion of the mantra?
premises: The instruction refers to the end of the mantra
She is called ever-moist and flowing with rapture
inference: The mantra concludes by invoking the goddess as Nityaklinnā, ever moist and flowing with rapture
plain_english: At its end, O Supreme Goddess, are the names Nityaklinnā and Madadravā.
